'''Dorok Zalaster''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who had his bald head covered with tattoos of swirling designs, a scar ran from the top of his head, down the left side of his face.

==Biography==
Dorok was a criminal since he was a young pickpocket in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].
Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] Dorok was hiding in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] with his band of devoted pirates. His base was located on the isolated [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lanthrym]]. Dorok controlled a fleet consisting of ''[[The Last Thing]]'' and eight captured [[Tykannin Drive]] [[Redthorn-class scout ship]]s as well as 34 underlings.
